prompt:
A single compound was assayed by IC50 against a single protein target in two different assays, reported in the literature.

Compound SMILES: CCCCNc1ccc(C(=O)OCCN(C)C)cc1
Target (ChEMBL): CHEMBL4296

Assay A:
  Description: Inhibition of human NaV1.7 expressed in HEK293 cells by [14C]guanidinium influx assay
  Assay type: B
  ChEMBL confidence score: 9
  Organism: Homo sapiens
  Cell type: HEK293

Assay B:
  Description: Inhibition of recombinant human NaV1.7 alpha subunit expressed in HEK293 cells at -65 mV holding potential by patch clamp electrophysiological assay
  Assay type: B
  ChEMBL confidence score: 9
  Organism: Homo sapiens
  Cell type: HEK293

Will the two reported IC50 values agree closely (within 0.3 log units), or differ substantially (more than 1.0 log units)?

Respond with exactly this JSON and nothing else:
{"call": "COMMENSURABLE" | "NOT_COMMENSURABLE" | "INSUFFICIENT_INFO",
 "confidence": <float 0-1>,
 "error_class": "assay_method" | "buffer_conditions" | "construct_mutant" | "organism" | "readout_type" | "potency_range" | "none" | "other",
 "reason": "<one sentence>"}

"COMMENSURABLE" means you expect the two reported values to agree closely.
"NOT_COMMENSURABLE" means you expect them to differ substantially.
error_class is your primary reason for a NOT_COMMENSURABLE call, else "none".
raw: {"call": "NOT_COMMENSURABLE", "confidence": 0.78, "error_class": "assay_method", "reason": "The guanidinium influx assay measures bulk ion flux and often yields different IC50 values compared to patch clamp electrophysiology, which is voltage-controlled and sensitive to holding potential; for NaV channels, holding potential strongly influences state-dependent block, making IC50 values from these two methodologies likely to diverge by more than 1 log unit."}

parsed.reason: The guanidinium influx assay measures bulk ion flux and often yields different IC50 values compared to patch clamp electrophysiology, which is voltage-controlled and sensitive to holding potential; for NaV channels, holding potential strongly influences state-dependent block, making IC50 values from these two methodologies likely to diverge by more than 1 log unit.
